Neither the sustainability report nor the annual results announcement gives employees or plants by province or by overseas country, nor a list of domestic production bases with locations; sites are limited to the HQ and the two overseas car plants the filings describe as operating in 2024 (the Brazil base and the Hungary plant are mentioned but without status or location detail, so they are left out). Uzbekistan factory is BYD UZBEKISTAN FACTORY LLC, listed as a joint venture.
